title: 5 Greatest Shonen Anime Rivalries, Ranked (#1 Will Be Forever Iconic)
content: Shonen Jump from Shueisha has emerged as arguably the most influential magazine in the anime and manga industry, producing many great series that have helped define the shonen genre. One of the greatest elements to emerge from these Shonen Jump series is their iconic rivalries.
author: ComicBook

title: Live-Action Film Tazza: The Song of Beelzebub Sets September Release
content: The upcoming live-action film Tazza: The Song of Beelzebub , based on the final installment of Young-man Hur's iconic Tazza manhwa series, has confirmed a September theatrical release in South Korea. The production also unveiled its first teaser poster and trailer on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Magical Girl and Narco Wars Manga Ends on July 21
content: Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service publishes the manga in English and describes the story: "Candy," a mysterious drug whose main ingredient is just ordinary sugar, is spreading like wildfire in Tokyo.
author: ANN

title: Berserk Brings Back Major Villains For The First Time in Years
content: Earlier this summer, Berserk finally returned to the world of manga after almost a year in limbo. Luckily, the comeback wasted little time in completely changing the world of Guts and the Band of the Hawk.
author: ComicBook

title: Agent Kim Reactivated Becomes 1st Korean Live-Action Series to Feature Fully AI-Generated Story Sequence
content: Agent Kim: Reactivated , live-action adaptation of the the webtoon Manager Kim , has become the first Korean live-action series to feature a fully AI-generated story sequence spanning three minutes, according to AI production company Morpheus Studio.
author: ANN

title: Mushoku Tensei: Redundant Reincarnation Epilogue Novels End With 4th Volume
content: Seven Seas Entertainment is releasing the novel series in English, and it describes the story ( WARNING: May contain spoilers for the main Mushoku Tensei novel series ): Rudeus Greyrat has finally emerged victorious from the showdown at Biheiril Kingdom.
author: ANN

title: Villains Are Destined to Die Webtoon Concludes Main Story in Korea
content: The Villains Are Destined to Die webtoon, based on the web novel of the same name, concluded its main story on Kakao Page in South Korea on Friday bringing its nearly five-year serialization to an end with Chapter 214.
author: ANN

title: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Anime's 2nd Part Debuts in October
content: Kadokawa revealed on Friday that the second cours (quarter of a year) of the television anime of Hiromu and raemz 's Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle ( Chitose-kun wa Ramune Bin no Naka ) light novel series will debut in October. The staff also revealed a promotional video.
author: ANN

title: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Second Cour Releases New Trailer
content: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Second Cour released a new trailer on Friday and is set to premiere in October 2026. The first cour concluded last March. author: Anime Corner

title: Live-Action Happy Kanako's Killer Life Series Gets 2nd Season
content: The DMM TV streaming service announced on Friday that the live-action series of Toshiya Wakabayashi 's Happy Kanako's Killer Life ( Shiawase Kanako no Koroshiya Seikatsu ) manga will have a second season that will debut on DMM TV in September.
author: ANN
